verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a game engine with scripting and extension APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. A community remark that Godot 3.5.2 is the LTS version and a godot_version query parameter on the Asset Library API do not amount to a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
